findings.title: Value not declared in the contract token plan

evidence.snippet: background-color: var(--paper) | #edf1f0 is not among the declared values black, white

findings.fix: Either use a declared token or add the value to the contract token plan.
findings.why: A color the contract never declared means the artifact invented part of its own palette.

findings.title: Section family not in the contract layout plan

evidence.snippet: family hero is not in the plan (split asymmetric, statement stat, proof grid, side by side comparison, close action)

findings.fix: Rebuild the section with a family from the plan, or amend the contract.
findings.why: The contract fixed the layout families: a section outside the plan means the build drifted from the ruling.
